[IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p328/r9] IBNASHUR-FULL, d. 1393 · author | holds | The author notes this motif in the Muʿallaqāt of Ṭarafa, Labīd, and al-Ḥārith, in rajaz poetry by al-Ḥajjāj and his son, and in Dhū al-Rumma.
